🚨URGENT APPEAL: Include the National Coastal Greenbelt bill in the legislative priority agenda 

Dear Mr. President,

"Mangroves are an essential part of our way of life in the province, particularly for fisherfolk and those who live near the sea; they serve as the nursery of the sea. Without them, the food supply in the province will be greatly depleted since there will be fewer fish to catch, which means less food for our families on the table.

As an environmentalist and an officer of Bayanihan Para sa Kalikasan Movement, Inc. and GPP Kalikasan Muna - Green Party of the Philippines, our organization is not just asking for the protection of trees; we are asking for the protection of food security — for ourselves and for future generations.

Mangroves will also protect coastal towns from the dangers of climate change and extreme weather events, as Bulacan is now increasingly at risk for flooding and climate disaster."

#DavidDAngelo
#BosesNgKalikasan
#KalikasanMuna

-----

Mangroves are natural climate heroes. 🌿🌊 They are strong natural barriers that protect our communities from storm surges, floods, and the worsening impacts of climate change. But they’re disappearing fast. 

IT’S TIME TO ACT: Join us in calling on the President @bongbongmarcos to prioritize the National Coastal Greenbelt bill—a crucial step toward protecting our coasts, our people, and our future. 

📝 Write a letter. Raise your voice with us. We're inviting the youth, fisherfolk, civil society groups, environmental advocates, and every concerned Filipino to make a stand for the mangroves. 

📢 Take action today. Visit ✍ https://t.co/bb07rCUCVt to write your letter and be part of the movement. Together, we can build a stronger, safer coastline for generations to come. 

#DearMrPresidentPH #CoastalGreenbeltNow

TRAFFIC ADVISORY - June 3rd ⚠️ 🚗

Please be advised that the new traffic lights at the intersection of Greenwood Drive and Pope Road will begin flashing mode today and remain in flashing operation for 7 days, with full signal activation scheduled for Monday, June 9th.

𝐅𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐋𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐎𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬:
 
𝐅𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐘𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰: Proceed with caution. You do not need to stop, but be alert and yield to traffic in the intersection or approaching from other directions.

𝐅𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐑𝐞𝐝: Stop completely. Treat it like a stop sign. Proceed only when the way is clear and safe.

This flashing period allows drivers to adjust to the presence of the new signal and increases overall safety before the light becomes fully operational.

#Summerside
